items.title: Initial frontend assessment
items.detail: Architecture, realtime, state ownership and performance emerged as strong areas; exact JavaScript semantics became the highest interview risk.

items.title: Real interview gaps recorded
items.detail: Compound Components, Context vs store, GRASP, coupling/cohesion, browser cross-tab APIs, Service Worker caching, GraphQL trade-offs and advanced TypeScript were promoted in priority.

items.title: One-week interview sprint active
items.detail: Days 1–3 focus on breadth; Days 4–6 on depth and reasoning; Day 7 is a no-hint mock interview.

items.title: Progress dashboard architecture selected
items.detail: Astro + TypeScript selected for the GitHub Pages dashboard. This infrastructure milestone does not change proficiency.
